description: FastAPI route handlers for claim management in a fact verification platform, including creating, retrieving, and listing claims with associated sources and analysis.

methods.name: _serialize_source
methods.description: Serializes a source document into a SourceItem schema.

methods.name: _serialize_claim
methods.description: Serializes a claim document along with optional sources and analysis into a ClaimItem schema.

methods.name: create_claim
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new claim, enqueue background processing, and return job info.

methods.name: get_claim
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve claim details, including sources and analysis.

methods.name: get_claim_status
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the current processing status of a claim.

methods.name: list_claims
methods.description: API endpoint to list claims with optional filters and pagination.
